title: Similar Triangles: Proportional Sides
body:
In the diagram, triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF with $$\angle A = \angle D$$, $$\angle B = \angle E$$, and $$\angle C = \angle F$$.

Given: AB = 6 cm, BC = 8 cm, AC = 10 cm, and DE = 9 cm.

a) Calculate the length of EF.
b) Calculate the length of DF.
